mechanism.claim: At an actual funding settlement after a high-variation eight-hour cycle, same-direction spot and perpetual returns with larger absolute spot displacement and same-direction spot aggressive flow identify cash-led price discovery. When the settled funding sign is adverse to that direction, derivatives remain under-positioned; continue in the cash-led direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed spot return, perpetual return, and spot aggressive quote flow
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSLAF uses the conjunction of spot displacement leadership, spot aggressive-flow confirmation, and opposite-sign actual settled funding. It uses no OI, alt, FX, post-settlement confirmation, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC perpetual variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the actual-settlement clock plus spot/perpetual magnitude ordering, spot flow, and adverse funding conjunction is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.cycle: 480 exact coherent one-minute Binance spot and perpetual BTCUSDT rows [S-8h,S)
features.perpetual_return: sum of 480 minute ln(perpetual close/open) returns, finite strict nonzero
features.spot_return: sum of 480 minute ln(spot close/open) returns, finite strict nonzero
features.spot_flow_share: sum(2*spot taker_buy_quote-spot quote_asset_volume)/sum(spot quote_asset_volume), finite strict nonzero
features.cash_leadership: spot and perpetual returns have one strict sign, spot flow has that sign, and abs(spot_return)>abs(perpetual_return)
features.funding_adversity: finite nonzero funding_rate[S] has the strict opposite sign to spot_return
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute perpetual returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid settlement cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact source-valid cycle, cash leadership, adverse settled funding, and variation rank passes

clock.decisions: actual BTCUSDT funding settlements, normally 00/08/16 UTC
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: trigger settlement precedes entry; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.perpetual: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.spot: Postgres bars_binance_spot BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC, quote_asset_volume, and taker_buy_quote
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no settlement, source, leadership, flow, funding, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
